verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
O let the Son of God enfold You
With His Spirit and His love

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
Let Him fill your heart
And satisfy your soul

verse.name: v1c
verse.lines:
O let Him have the things that
Hold You

verse.name: v1d
verse.lines:
And His Spirit like a dove
Will descend upon your life
And make you whole

verse.name: c1
verse.lines:
Jesus, O Jesus
Come and fill Your Lambs (x2)

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines: O come and sing this song with gladness

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
As your hearts are filled with joy
Lift your hands in sweet surrender
To His name

verse.name: v2c
verse.lines:
O give Him all your tears and sadness
Give Him all your years of pain

verse.name: v2d
verse.lines:
And you'll enter into life
In Jesus' name
